name: gitlab-workbench
description: GitLab workbench monorepo: VS Code extension, web app, API and shared domain logic

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace=gitlab-auto-merge-request && npm run build --workspace=@gitlab-workbench/api && npm run build --workspace=@gitlab-workbench/web
scripts.compile: npm run build:core && npm run compile --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:extension: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace=gitlab-auto-merge-request
scripts.package:vsix: npm run build:core && npm run package:vsix --workspace=gitlab-auto-merge-request
